name: day-trader-skill-nse
description: The Day Trader skill pack for Claude, ported to the NSE (India)

plugins.name: day-trader-skill-nse
plugins.description: Ten Claude skills for intraday trading on the NSE: a chart scanner, a news monitor (NSE announcements and board meetings), an entry timer, an exit planner, a time machine that replays 10,000 sessions, a risk manager, a budget manager (rupees, tick sizes, charges), an order executor for Zerodha or Angel One (paper by default, never without your yes), price alerts and a paper-trading autopilot that runs the morning for you and stops at your yes.
